title: Results
description: Q3 results.json — the single machine-readable record of a finished run, filled by every flavor as generated::Results (src/io/output/results.hpp), written as <prefix>_results.json and returned verbatim by the Python bindings, grouped by domain: structure (the material), provenance (how the result was produced), properties (the physical properties, ESSE records under properties.records) and runtime_log (how the calculation ran). Every object is closed (additionalProperties: false), so these schemas are the complete list of keys a reader may encounter, and a key added to the writer without being added here fails the regression suite. Every quantity carries its unit in its own units field; no key carries a unit in its name.
